name: Potion of Heroism
summary: A potion that grants 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effect of Bless for 1 hour.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the *{ref:spell/bless}* spell (no Concentration required).

This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.
